author: anon-df5e95db
content: Observation: faidx_t is opaque in Rust FFI (struct { _unused: [u8; 0] }). Cannot access internal fields. Will use construction-time caching: call C FFI once at Reader creation to build seq_names Vec and seq_lengths HashMap, then serve all lookups from Rust-owned data. Same pattern as HeaderView id_cache.
